name: witcher-hud
description: A Witcher 3 style HUD for Claude Code: a medallion that casts a sign for each tool, vitality for the context left, stamina for the rate limit, adrenaline for clean tool streaks, XP and levels for tokens, crowns for cost, a quest tracker for the prompt at hand, and a character sheet on hover; dark or light parchment, after the app

language.title: Language
language.description: The HUD's language: en for English, ru for Russian (Русский)

theme.title: Theme
theme.description: The desktop HUD's look: auto follows the app's light or dark appearance, dark keeps the dark plate, light the parchment
